messages:
Anna P (partnerships): quick sync — Sherpa Edge Dataflow pilot. Can Sherpa confirm on-prem vector DB can expose the connector we need for Snowflake external functions + Databricks Delta ingestion?
Tom S (sherpa-partner): yes — Sherpa can run an edge appliance exposing a gRPC ingestion endpoint. We support S3-compatible export and a small HTTP shim for Snowflake external functions.
Anna P (partnerships): awesome. two asks: 1) a minimal ops runbook for customers (install, certs, firewall rules). 2) an integration package for our connector team (jar/docker + sample configs).
Tom S (sherpa-partner): got it. i'll upload a draft runbook by EOD tomorrow. sample config will include TLS + mTLS snippets.
Miguel G (eng): for Redwood runtime, we need a stable manifest for the connector (image, tag, env vars) and a healthcheck endpoint. can Sherpa expose /healthz returning 200 and JSON {"status":"ok"}?
Tom S (sherpa-partner): yes, /healthz exists. sample response is `{"status":"ok","version":"1.2.0-edge"}`. we'll add env var RUN_MODE=edge and provide image: ghcr.io/sherpa/edge-connector:1.2.0.
Priya R (product): timeline check — we're aiming for a joint pilot with 2 customers (one on Snowflake, one on Databricks) in 6 weeks. marketing needs a rough announcement draft for review in week 4.
Kate L (sales): flagging two enterprise prospects who want this pattern. need clarity on data residency + contract language re: on-prem support. legal will want the runbook and security checklist.
Miguel G (eng): tech checklist from our side: TLS mutual auth, cert rotation instructions, a sample integration test (ingest 10K vectors -> query latencies), and a fallback path to Redwood-hosted vector when on-prem is down.
Tom S (sherpa-partner): we can provide cert rotation scripts and a small python test harness. fallback behaviour: we can return 503 with header `X-Sherpa-Fallback: true` so Redwood runtime can trigger remote routing.
Anna P (partnerships): perfect. can we get an initial artifact drop (runbook + sample config + test harness) by 1839992000? that gives eng two weeks to wire tests.
Tom S (sherpa-partner): target noted. will aim for that.
Miguel G (eng): i'll own the integration test and the fallback routing in runtime. assigning myself to create the test harness task: `ENG-connector-sherpa-1`.
Priya R (product): i'll draft a joint pilot one-pager and coordinate legal + GTM. who owns the marketplace listing checklist?
Kate L (sales): I can lead marketplace checklist with partner ops. need the packaging format (OCI image + connector manifest) and an acceptance criteria doc.
ops-bot: reminder: create channel `#pilot-sherpa-edge` and add stakeholders.
Anna P (partnerships): created channel and added folks. next sync Friday 10am PT. agenda: runbook review, test harness status, legal checklist, announcement draft.
Tom S (sherpa-partner): thanks. i'll post the draft artifacts to the channel and link the repo. link: https://github.com/sherpa/edge-connector (private until pilot).
Miguel G (eng): small nit: please include a sample Snowflake external function snippet in the repo. something like:
```
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION SHERPA_EMBED(vector VARIANT)
RETURNS VARIANT
LANGUAGE JAVASCRIPT
RUNTIME_VERSION = '1.0'
HANDLER = 'handler'
AS 'https://sherpa-edge.example.com/external_fn';
```
Tom S (sherpa-partner): will add that.
Priya R (product): thanks all. tagging timeline owners: @Tom S (artifacts), @Miguel G (integration tests), @Kate L (marketplace packaging), @Legal (review).
Anna P (partnerships): ✅ closing notes: pilot goal = validate on-prem latency & failover, verify packaging for marketplace, and co-marketing plan. see you Friday. :rocket:
